name: intake-1706
about: 1706 alone in TELEOP: its arm swings out over the bumper on its Motion Magic, pushing the hopper box out; it drives into the NEUTRAL ZONE's FUEL with its rollers running, up the sloped plate into the hopper under its slack net, the spindexers' bowls; then it turns with its load and lets go, the arm folding back in and the box with it (M3c).
